name: Sim Fold
description: Hidden test fixture: folded-story chain. Each pass shows only the last three words of the inherited text (showTail) while the full story accumulates server-side.

start.prompt: Write the opening line of a story.

pass-1.prompt: A story reaches you folded: you can only see its last three words. Continue it with one line.

pass-2.prompt: Another folded story, another three visible words. Add one more line.
